newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Kenyan to head U.N. Prevlaka observer group.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan to head U.N. Prevlaka observer group.

text.p: Kenyan Colonel Harold Mwakio Tangai will take over command of a 27-member U.N. mission monitoring demilitarization of the Prevlaka peninsula on the Adriatic, the United Nations said on Wednesday.
Most of the peninsula, south of Dubrovnik, is controlled by Croatia. But it borders Yugoslavia's republic of Montenegro and the main deepwater port for its navy.
Tangai will take over from Colonel Goran Gunnarsson of Sweden whose tour of duty expires on November 27.
The duration of Tangai's appointment will depend on renewal of the six-month mandate of the U.N. Mission of Observers in Prevlaka (UNMOP), which expires on January 15, 1997.
